scope: The reviewed runtime switch of the staging broker (build order PR 7; ADR-0029 item 10, which this record implements in place of infra/labs/e2b-activation.json for the new runtime port; ADR-0035 item 6). Committed off: the broker reads no E2B_API_KEY even if the owner placed it ahead of the switch, RuntimeBroker.runtimeExecute and runtimeSweep answer BROKER_HELD (RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE) before any input, database or provider access, no runtime adapter is composed (the E2B adapter is PR 8's), no template is pinned (the owner's build) and nothing is qualified, so no sandbox can be created, and no sandbox the provider does not find is ever counted as absent. cleanup_only reconciles and kills (the sweep) and creates nothing; on also admits creates. `on` needs qualification first (ADR-0029 item 11, under ADR-0035 item 4): qualified_on and the docs/evidence/live/ record of the canary run (egress denied, the envd token unreadable by the guest user, timeouts that kill without pausing); any template, region or adapter change voids it. `merchant` admission (the owner's product data rather than synthetic data) needs `on` and qualification. The runtime image is the staging broker's var MORROW_RUNTIME_SWITCH (exactly on or cleanup_only) and E2B_API_KEY in its secrets.required, both only while the switch is not off; edge:check refuses any mixed state. While off the owner may still place the key ahead of the switch, only with `npm run staging:put-secret -- E2B_API_KEY --while-runtime-off`, read from the owner's chmod-600 file e2b-api-key and never from argv; gate 6 and secrets-status then accept it present or absent. monthly_budget_usd is the code's runtime budget (packages/policy/src/runtime-computer.ts runtimeCaps and migration 0043's runtime_caps, drift-tested), below the E2B project's usage limit. Production has no switch until the ADR-0007 item 9 custody ADR.
